answer: Draw juries by subnetwork, not by stake. Every claim carries an anchor, its oldest unrelated attestation, and a panel that shares one host or one funding source is void, sending the claim back to the queue. A second checker outside the first panel's graph re-runs the work and is paid only when it finds something. Buying identities widens a garden of clones without deepening it, so each extra seat cancels another and a spiral of collusion shows up as repeated voids.
